name: add-op
tagline_zh: 写代码的顺手工具：add-op。英文简介见下。
desc_en: Add new operator definitions to PyPTO across all layers (C++, Python IR, Python DSL, tests, codegen, docs). Covers tile ops, tensor ops, tensor-to-tile conversion, and codegen registration. Use when the user asks to add a new op, define a new operator, implement a new tile/tensor operation, or extend the operator system.
